title: CW: make every sign-off sheet clear to John in one reading
public_pr_body:
CW: reads and rewrites all twelve sign-off masters for a non-technical shop director. Explains decisions and terms, identifies who does the technical work, and keeps exact IDs/settings/URLs in explained copy lists. Preserves choices, blank signatures/results, company separation, financial/backup/MFA/provider controls and the 146 recovery stop.

The source forms live on twelve separate draft PRs. This one CW draft gathers them as a replacement set; original branches are unchanged. `docs/signoff/CW-PLAIN-WORDS-REVIEW.md` pins each source head and change; `docs/signoff/HANDOVER-BUILDER-4-CW.md` records validation/remaining work. Base is the updated #314 review draft, so its valid corrections remain.

Validation: source/editorial/date/example/identifier comparison and git diff --check. Documentation only; no artificial unit tests. John training/printing/signatures, live portal/account actions, database/provider/browser/restore proofs remain NOT RUN. No scope/policy/implementation change, Ready label, main merge, production SQL or deployment.

Final CW publication head: 359249878c17b7e4586e39bbee4b7e3961c2a2e2. Review base snapshot: c9ef232e90672846c1d0d10b2a06b73175a6716d; keep later #314/BA corrections when combining drafts.
